From the perspective of cross-strait relations, the Chinese government adheres to the basic policy of "peaceful reunification and one country, two systems" and is committed to promoting the peaceful development of cross-strait relations and the enhancement of compatriots' well-being. At the same time, we also clearly express our principle of not allowing any form of secession, which is an important guarantee for maintaining regional stability and safeguarding national interests.

In short, "Taiwan independence" is not in line with the historical development trend and the general expectation of the people. Its negative impact on cross-strait relations will be extremely adverse.
